paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tosefta Makhshirin 3:2; Hyman reports that Zuckermandel’s Tosefta has Chilfata ben Kuyna.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Mechon Mamre Tosefta Makhshirin 3:2 paragraph writes abbreviated R' Chalafta ben Kuyna, so the new heading retains R'. Hyman’s Chilfata spelling in Zuckermandel is expressly his report, without fresh Zuckermandel collation. The other named authorities and legal discussion are not imported or linked.
